fields: Mandatory rows: proof is always required. Optional rows: proof may be required depending on your accumulator concept – if it is, it must be included. Answer Yes only when the linked tab really shows the proof.

evidence: Drawings and images of the TSAC: materials used, fastener locations, section weight, cell and section position.
Colour-code all walls/panels/lay-ups; three-view drawings and isometric views.
TPL Accumulator Pics
Side view in chassis with height marked – TSAC must lie fully inside the primary structure and not exceed the impact-structure height in side view.

Steel/aluminium minimum thickness: floor 1.25 mm steel / 3.2 mm Al; walls, covers, lids 0.9 mm steel / 2.3 mm Al. Other materials need proof of equivalency (T 3.4 / EV 5.5.6) and test samples at Technical Inspection.
fields: Measured metallic sheet thickness. Minimum: floor 1.25 mm steel / 3.2 mm Al; walls & cover 0.9 mm steel / 2.3 mm Al.
How the composite equivalency to T 3.4 is proven (refer to your 3-point-bending/shear tabs).
images: Side view with the height clearly marked (TSAC must not exceed the impact structure height in side view).

evidence: Test panel: same design, laminate and process as the TSAC part. 275 × 500 mm (span ≥ 400 mm, metallic applicator R 50 mm), or for TSAC core ≤ 5 mm: 150 × 275 mm (span ≥ 200 mm, applicator R ≥ 5 mm). Panel sides not laminated.
Pictures must show: support distance, load-applicator dimensions, and sample marking.
Load–deflection curve per panel.
TPL 3pt Bending tab
State material types, cloth weights, resin, fiber orientation, number of layers, core, lay-up technique, adhesive film.
Max. 50 % parallel fibers (±10° window) by weight.
Samples marked permanently (no sticker) with laminate acronym and test date, and brought to Technical Inspection.
Calculations and physical test results must be in the ASES; steel backing plates ≥ 2 mm at each attachment point.
Perimeter shear test: 25 mm flat punch, sample ≥ 100 × 100 mm, same core/skin thickness, materials and process; thinner skin faces the punch if asymmetrical.
Fixture supports the whole sample except a 32 mm coaxial hole; sample not clamped.
Enter BOTH peaks from the load curve.

TPL Datasheets tab
Fire retardant proof: UL94 V-0 (min. thickness), FAR 25.853(a)(1)(i), UL94 HF-1 (foams) or UL94 VTM-0; other standards only if approved before the event. Own tests need documentation.
fields: YES = datasheet shows one of the accepted fire ratings; 'Performed own test' = document the test (report, pictures) in this ASES.

evidence: Datasheet pages for every material used.
TPL Datasheets tab
Fire retardant proof per T 1.2.1 (UL94 V-0 / FAR 25.853 / UL94 HF-1 / UL94 VTM-0).
Non-metallic, non-continuous-fiber materials: mechanical properties at ≥ 60 °C – from datasheet (Tg/Vicat alone not enough), own documented tests, or scientific justification with knock-down factor.
R27 EV 5.5.3; TPL EV5.5.3 Guidance Notes
fields: YES = datasheet shows an accepted fire rating; 'Performed own test' = document the test in this ASES.

evidence: Datasheet pages for every adhesive used.

50 % reduction on all nominal and tested adhesive values for bonded joints.
fields: YES = datasheet shows an accepted fire rating; 'Performed own test' = document the test in this ASES.

evidence: Pictures of the cell fixation showing the force path.
TPL Cell Fixation tab
Pouch cells: fixed only via the large surface(s), ≥ 80 % of each used surface; tabs must not press into the pouch. Document how pretension is applied.
Proof that cell stress ≤ 0.05 MPa shear and ≤ 1.0 MPa compression (or datasheet limit if lower), using 80 % of the nominal large surface.
Friction-based fixation: physical friction test (real cell or representative mock-up), several pressures, several runs each; results table, setup pictures, chosen coefficient argued.
R27 EV 5.5.15; TPL EV5.5.12 Guidance Notes
fields: Coefficient from your own friction test – not from literature. Describe the test in 'Fixation concept, calculations, friction test'.
R27 EV 5.5.15; TPL EV5.5.12 Guidance Notes
Clamping (pretension) force. The method used to apply it must be documented.
Supported on both sides: cells between supports ÷ 2. Supported on one side: all cells on that support.

evidence: Show for every part/interface and every direction X, Y, Z: 40 g longitudinal, 40 g lateral, 20 g vertical.
R27 EV 5.5.8, T 3.3.1; TPL EV5.5.9 Guidance Notes
Analytical calculations always required; FEM only supportive and must have legends, model description, readable numbers and mesh info – otherwise direct FAIL.
TPL EV5.5.9 Guidance Notes
Parts in the high-current path must not carry mechanical loads.
Show every direction X, Y, Z: 40 g / 40 g / 20 g.
Analytical calculations always required; FEM without legends/model/mesh info = FAIL.
TPL EV5.5.9 Guidance Notes
Bonded joints: 50 % reduction on adhesive values.
At least 2 attachment points; brackets ≥ 1.6 mm steel or ≥ 4 mm aluminium, with gussets for bending loads.
Show every direction X, Y, Z: 40 g / 40 g / 20 g.
Bolted TSAC-to-chassis tabs/brackets: edge distance e/D ≥ 1.5.
Analytical calculations preferred; FEM without legends/model/mesh info = FAIL.
TPL EV5.5 TSAC Attachment Guidance
Show all fasteners in groups with (CAD) pictures, even those exempt from T 10.
TPL Fasteners tab
Fasteners within or mounting the TSAC follow T 10; non-structural ones inside (e.g. PCBs) are exempt from T 10.1.2; non-conductive non-structural ones inside are exempt from T 10.
Critical threaded fasteners: steel, ≥ M4 grade 8.8, strength class identifiable; hex bolts or socket head cap screws.
fields: Name the positive locking mechanism used for this group.

evidence: Each section ≤ 120 V DC, ≤ 6 MJ, ≤ 12 kg.
Sections separated by internal vertical walls up to the lid.
Holes only for harness, ventilation, cooling or fasteners; total cutout < 25 % per wall; external holes sealed (EV 4.5).
External openings/ducts not pointing at driver or hand-cart operator; ducts fire retardant and sealed.
Ventilation if gas can vent; pressure relief valve if fully sealed.
AIRs and main fuse separated from the accumulator by insulating, fire-retardant material (air not accepted).
Images with dimensions and labels.
